verdict.summary: Round 2 remains correct and complete. The workflow now consumes an exhaustively paginated, normalized REST issue queue; excludes pull requests; fails closed on API errors, invalid timestamps, and runaway result counts; and runs the focused self-test before label mutations. The behavioral test exercises more than two pages, proves the oldest issue remains reachable, validates timestamp normalization through the real promotion predicate, preserves labels, and covers fetch and ceiling failures. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity issue is evident. Findings are materially unchanged from round 1 (none), so progress is stagnant under the required scale.
